methodology: Preliminary Qur'an verse-by-verse motif screening only; candidate passages have NOT been checked against original-language critical editions. No assertion of textual dependence, no public promotion. 'No specific parallel established' is provisional, not proof of absence.
coverage_ledger_status: batch checkpoint only; NOT authoritative or merged; reconcile earlier open PRs before importing

entries.summary: Creation of heavens and earth, darkness and light; compare Genesis 1:1–5 only as creation motif
entries.caveat: Genesis distinguishes light/darkness; Qur'an stresses divine creation and rejects assigning equals

entries.summary: Human origin from clay and appointed term; compare Genesis 2:7
entries.caveat: Genesis depicts dust and divine breath; Qur'an emphasizes clay and divine appointment

entries.summary: Divine knowledge of hidden and manifest; broad theology not a distinctive narrative
Rejection of divine signs; generalized prophetic polemic
Rejection of truth and coming consequences
Destroyed earlier generations, prosperity and rain; compare Deuteronomy 8 and Amos 4 only as contrasting covenantal warning motifs
entries.caveat: Neither text supplies the specific unnamed generations of this verse

entries.summary: Written revelation on parchment rejected as magic
Demand for an angel and resulting judgment; compare Exodus 33:20 only as a contrast concerning divine encounter
entries.caveat: Exodus addresses seeing God, not a demand for an angel; very loose contrast

entries.summary: Angel messenger in human form and confusion
entries.caveat: Angelophanies are widespread; no passage-level match asserted without closer examination

entries.summary: Mockery of messengers and eventual reversal; compare 2 Chronicles 36:15–16 as a prophetic rejection motif
entries.caveat: Chronicles refers to Judah's rejection of messengers; not the same historical event
